description: This file implements the class methods for SurfaceVk, a Vulkan surface class in ANGLE, including swapchain management, surface initialization, and rendering target handling.

classes.name: SurfaceVk
classes.description: Implements Vulkan surface methods, manages swapchains, and rendering targets.

classes.name: OffscreenSurfaceVk
classes.description: Represents an offscreen Vulkan surface with its own images and render targets.

classes.name: WindowSurfaceVk
classes.description: Represents a window Vulkan surface with swapchain management, presentation, and overlays.

methods.name: getAttachmentRenderTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the render target for a given attachment (color or depth/stencil).

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the surface, including creating swapchains and images.

methods.name: initializeImpl
methods.description: Performs detailed initialization of the surface, including surface capabilities and swapchain setup.

methods.name: recreateSwapchain
methods.description: Recreates the swapchain, handling old swapchains and synchronization.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates a new Vulkan swapchain with specified parameters.

methods.name: nextSwapchainImage
methods.description: Acquires the next image from the swapchain for rendering.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Performs buffer swap operations.

methods.name: swapWithDamage
methods.description: Performs buffer swap with damage rects for partial updates.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Handles presentation of the swapchain image, including overlays and synchronization.

methods.name: checkForOutOfDateSwapchain
methods.description: Checks and recreates the swapchain if window size or presentation parameters have changed.

methods.name: releaseSwapchainImages
methods.description: Releases images associated with the swapchain.

methods.name: destroySwapChainImages
methods.description: Destroys swapchain images and related resources.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates a default framebuffer for rendering.

methods.name: getCurrentFramebuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the current framebuffer for rendering.

methods.name: getAcquireImageSemaphore
methods.description: Returns the semaphore used for image acquisition.

methods.name: initializeContents
methods.description: Initializes the contents of the swapchain images.

methods.name: updateAndDrawOverlay
methods.description: Updates and draws overlay information on the surface.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval and updates present mode accordingly.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the surface width.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the surface height.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Indicates if post sub-buffer is supported.

methods.name: getSwapBehavior
methods.description: Returns the swap behavior type.
